title: Synthesis of graphene layers on polycrystalline Ni foil using liquid ethanol
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,47938-47945
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06724C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Junhao Zhou, Yefei Guo, Elena Voloshina, Yuriy Dedkov
We demonstrate an easy and technologically relevant approach for the successful growth of monolayer and multilayer graphene layers on polycrystalline nickel (Ni-poly) substrates using liquid ethanol (C2H5OH) as a carbon precursor.
